text:
Chuck Grassley addresses government shutdowns and national security concerns in July tweets
I. S. Corley
Senator Chuck Grassley, a long-serving U.S. Senator from Iowa and one of only two farmers in the Senate, posted several messages on July 21, 2026, addressing government shutdowns, energy security, and judicial appointments.
In a post made at 16:20 UTC, Grassley questioned Democratic motives regarding federal funding negotiations: "It costs taxpayer$ to shut down govt & costs $ to open govt back up Why do Dems want to shutdown govt again like they did last yr???".
Later that day at 22:16 UTC, Grassley cited comments from a Senate Appropriations hearing: "Wise words frm Scty Rollins at Senate Appropriations hrg 2day: 'As long as we are beholden to foreign and even hostile countries for our food and our fuel our freedom is in jeopardy' US SENATE MUST PASS E15 ASAP bc energy security = natl security".
At 22:28 UTC on the same day, Grassley congratulated Kara Westercamp on her confirmation as a judge: "Congrats 2 Cedar Rapids native & UIowa alum Kara Westercamp for her confirmation 2b US Court of International Trade Judge IOWA is proud of u".
Grassley's background includes earning degrees in political science from the University of Northern Iowa and serving in the Iowa state legislature from 1958 to 1974 (official website). He brings experience as a factory worker and continues to raise corn and soybeans in Butler County, Iowa. In addition to his legislative work, he assists Iowans with matters involving federal agencies and whistleblowers. Married since 1954 with five children, Grassley's career has spanned decades of public service.
